rootCauses: The two original vouchersXml payloads were 323 bytes each and contained zero structured vouchers. There were no stored quotations for the UI to display.
Existing quotation and enquiry screens queried only CRM workflow tables; Tally source documents had no dedicated presentation.

The generic connector voucher request did not explicitly request optional/cancelled flags or all nested quotation methods, and its accounting history checkpoints were not a dedicated historical sales-document refresh.

Tally returned 570 Sales Quotation records: 123 non-optional and 447 optional, including one cancelled optional quotation. Treating 123 as the entire XML population would hide delivered optional documents.

findings.originalVoucherTypeFilter: No voucher-type exclusion in the original generic request; it filtered dates.
findings.originalCancelledOptionalFilter: No explicit exclusion in the inspected generic request. The original field list did not request these flags.
findings.discardedStructuredVouchers: Original audited payloads contained none; parser correctly ignored scalar counters.
findings.wrongDatabaseTable: Source imports belong in the existing append-only Tally visibility storage, not the independently approved editable CRM workflow.
findings.pagination: Server-side pagination remains enabled; no first-page-only import.
findings.dateCoverage: Actual returned quotation dates are 2023-04-06 through 2024-03-31; no later Sales Quotation records were returned by the date-window probes.
findings.companyIsolation: Source keys and all list/detail queries are company scoped.

migration.name: 0032_tally_sales_documents.sql
migration.changes: Safe source metadata projection and company/date/status indexes. Financial amounts retain existing Owner/Accounts restrictions. CRM-created quotations and enquiry records are untouched.

frontend: Tally imports and CRM tabs on existing Quotations and Enquiries pages
Original item, ledger, tax-rate and discount fields; explicit Not supplied labels
Detailed raw-field search with original source IDs, timestamps, source relationships and history
Source type breakdown showing optional/non-optional/cancelled populations
synchronization: Read-only Export requests only; no Tally write-back
Separate salesDocumentsXml collection refresh from company books-start date on each connector sync cycle
Wildcard quotation/enquiry field requests; existing accounting fetch remains bounded
GUID or Master ID required for sales-document identity; missing IDs are quarantined
Company-scoped stable keys, append-only snapshots, latest-record cache, idempotent retries
Modified content detected; cancelled/deleted source markers retained
Missing-from-snapshot records preserved and flagged, never silently deleted
Original XML and parsed source records retained
Unsafe or malformed responses are recorded as failed; row-level identity failures are quarantined
Customer/item source links use source IDs or explicitly labelled unique exact source-name matches; ambiguous matches remain unresolved
